subject: Request: executive pre-brief + staggered arrival plan for OrionGrid demo
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jamie Li <jamie.li@oriongrid.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 9 Dec 2025 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: executive pre-brief + staggered arrival plan for OrionGrid demo

Hi Jamie,

Thanks again for locking in the demo next week. Quick ask from our side before the main session on Wednesday: your VP of Engineering and CTO indicated they'd like to attend the customer-facing demo but may need to drop in/out due to back-to-back sessions. To make things smooth, can we do a 20-minute executive pre-brief 30 minutes before the public demo starts?

Proposed schedule (Pacific time):
- 09:00–09:20 PT — Executive pre-brief (VP/CTO + 1) — high-level goals, success criteria, security notes
- 09:30–10:15 PT — Main demo (reds and ops team in the room)

If the VP/CTO need to arrive late, we can stagger the executive portion so they still see the 10-min product highlights. Also happy to provide a short one-pager that calls out SLOs, data handling, and the fallback plan if they have to step out.

Attached: a draft run-of-show and a one-pager that would be useful to share with execs.

Can you confirm who will attend the pre-brief and whether 09:00 PT works?

Thanks — I can coordinate calendar invites and a short tech dry run if helpful.

— Diego
Diego Fernandez
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: Jamie Li <jamie.li@oriongrid.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@oriongrid.com>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@oriongrid.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 9 Dec 2025 11:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: executive pre-brief + staggered arrival plan for OrionGrid demo

Diego,

Appreciate the proactive planning. 09:00 PT for the pre-brief works for our CTO (Elena) but the VP (Samir) has a conflicting board prep call until 09:10 PT, so he can join at ~09:12. Staggered/shortened exec pre-brief is perfect.

Attendees for the pre-brief: Elena Park (CTO), Samir Patel (VP, Product — may join at ~09:12), Jamie Li (AM).

Procurement looped in — they want the final vendor one-pager and a statement on data retention to attach to the SOW. Samir also asked if you can keep the exec pre-brief to high-level outcomes — no deep technical slides.

I’ll confirm calendar invites on my side once Marissa shares the Redwood invite. Also, Procurement would like a copy of any compliance slides in advance (SOC-2, data residency note).

Thanks,
Jamie
Jamie Li
Account Lead, OrionGrid
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jamie Li <jamie.li@oriongrid.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Dec 2025 08:00:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: executive pre-brief + staggered arrival plan for OrionGrid demo

Jamie / Diego — sending calendar invites now.

Calendar details (Pacific):
- Exec pre-brief (Redwood + OrionGrid execs): 2025-12-10 09:00–09:20 PT — Google Meet link included
- Main demo: 2025-12-10 09:30–10:15 PT — separate invite with dial-in and recording enabled

Attachments (sent with invite): oriongrid-demo-runofshow.pdf, redwood-exec-onepager.pdf, compliance-summary.pdf (procurement copy).

Diego — Ben asked I flag an internal backup for exec questions in case Samir has to leave mid-demo. Ben, please confirm who will be standby.

Jamie — noted on keeping the pre-brief high-level; the exec one-pager is two pages and calls out retention and security notes in plain language. If Procurement wants any additional artifacts, reply-all and we’ll drop them in.

— Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jamie Li <jamie.li@oriongrid.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Dec 2025 16:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: executive pre-brief + staggered arrival plan for OrionGrid demo

All — I’ll be the standby for exec Q&A during the main demo in case Samir needs to step out. Plan: I’ll hang in the main room, monitor chat, and jump to cover product/business questions. Diego, if there are any expected finance or procurement-specific asks, flag them and I’ll prep short answers.

Marissa — confirmed the attachments looked good; small edit suggestion to the one-pager on the fallback model (two lines) — I pushed a corrected PDF to the shared invite.

See you all tomorrow.

— Ben
Ben Carter
VP, Solutions | Redwood Inference
